ns2:course.label: Pedagogy: Theory and Practice
ns2:course.description: This seminar offers professional preparation for graduate students in art history, art education, or the A+D MFA program who will be pursuing college or university teaching careers. Focus is on the development of course design and teaching techniques informed by current theories of teaching and learning. Special attention will be given to teaching the elements of visual analysis and interpretation. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Approved for S/U grading only.
